content: OpenStreetMap static map: the OSMF Tile Usage Policy forbids bulk downloading, pre-seeding and tile archives from tile.openstreetmap.org, and requires a distinctive User-Agent, an unstripped Referer, HTTPS, and cache discipline. Attribution: display 'Map data from OpenStreetMap' or the standard 'c OpenStreetMap contributors' visibly on/next to the image, ideally hyperlinked to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright; attribution can be omitted only for images with fewer than 100 features or covering under 10,000 m2, or for thumbnails. Practical read for a one-off committed build-time snapshot: generating a single small static image once, committing it, and captioning it with the attribution + copyright link is compatible with the policy (it is not systematic prefetching), but the safest routes are a self-run/permissively-licensed static-map renderer or an official OSM export, and the attribution caption is non-negotiable.
